lines: Status 209 · 2026-11-27 10:34 UTC · Phase 6

Decision needed from Brandon, unchanged, one thing only he can do: the automation that restarts this build ends Friday noon Mountain Time and a run may not move its own end. He can move the end to Sunday noon in the automation's settings, or write any line in the thread. The Partner raises it again Friday morning. Open item 252.

The sixth publish is live since 10:28 UTC Nov 27, from `3d6065fc` (the first pictures over chain 26's head). On the publish build: tsc exit 0, the whole vitest 68 files passed and 1 skipped, 942 tests passed and 9 skipped, build exit 0, engine `85cf73c2c01e9f16`, "poster: pass" on the 40 first pictures, 351 files. The fresh security reviewer answered "BLOCKS: no" with no warning. The deploy's record read verified and the publish answered "published". Visibility: Organization, so an unsigned request gets 401 (read at 10:29). It carries chains 16 to 26 over the fifth publish: the controls and the loading mends, spring's base to its sixth list, summer's tree to its tenth pass, summer's base to its seventh list, summer's miniature and sand lists, fall's scene to its seventh list, fall's base to its tenth step, fall's air to its sixth list. It does not carry chain 27 or chain 28.

The reviewer's one open point, answered by measure. It had seen the page's still end while the canvas stood at opacity 0.05. On a quiet helper machine, one page alone under the software renderer: the new build came into sight by itself at 20 s and the build published before it at 24 s, 0 console messages in both, 33 buttons (MEASURED). The same reading showed a fault that both builds share: where frames are few the page's clock runs behind the wall clock, the 1500 ms timer ends the still, and for 6 to 10 s the page is nearly black before the globe has faded in. On a card that gives 60 frames a second the fade ends in half a second (STATED, no machine here has a real card). Open item 253. The mend is ordered from the controls' builder: at no frame is the still gone and the canvas under full opacity. Picture 1 is the page as that helper read it.

Chain 28 runs since 10:29 UTC on `7af6dd93`: summer's air mend (one light where a bunch of dots stood), fall's air seventh list, summer's sand stream and the first pictures. So far on it: tsc exit 0, build exit 0, engine `0adcfb64f562108e`, "pass M3 summer-rest: 0.8781" (base 0.878, miniature 0.908) and "pass M3 fall-rest: 0.9129" (base 0.913, miniature 0.957). The stills, the change's two measures, the counts and the whole vitest are still running; read about 10:55 UTC.
Reports read since Status 208, each on its builder's own pictures and numbers, none a pass of the bar.

Summer's miniature, sixth list (`e5fc7e1e`, pushed, final report in): the fence stands as narrow posts with round tops and two rails (posts 7 px wide and 56 to 60 px tall at hd), the pond's post stripe is narrow and dark as the approved's, the white speck is gone, the far bank is five low stones. Not met in its own words: the lit strip is an even stubble where the approved has a few lit clumps in dark grass, the sand's lit column is half the approved's height for a cause in the glass's file, and the wall's grain is coarse at the close camera. Its crawl between film frames 1990 and 1991 reads 0.74, 0.81 and 0.24 percent of pixels over 12 levels in three boxes against main's 0.51, 0.72 and 0.10. M3 at review 0.8026 with the miniature's part 0.886 against 0.888. Held: it measures a little further from main in the crawl and brings a new fault at the close camera, so I asked for both to be taken back before it is merged. Pictures 2 and 3.

Fall's scene, eighth list: the first round (`67a1de1f`) took the chimney's part from 0.68 to 0.89 and lowered the whole from 0.874 to 0.8554, held; the second round reads 0.8724 with the fence, the blades and the door ring mended and the wall worse by its own three measures. Ordered: the wall back to round one's or to the approved's measures, the fence's count of posts to the approved's (count is layout, decision 184), seven rows on the roof.

Fall's base, first pair of the twelfth step (a look, not a push): the wall reads as lumpy rock and no longer as cloth, the shaded stone's median 16.1 against the approved's 15.9, M3 0.8742. Still wrong by its own eye: the vines are orange dashes on thick tubes where the approved has a tangle of thin dark twigs.

Fall's air, measures before it deals: the approved's upper air holds 14 green patches where ours holds 2, and its two large discs have an edge of 0.21 and 0.27 of the radius where ours have 0.13 to 0.17.

Summer's tree, eleventh pass (`eb0b36da`, pushed 10:29 UTC, report in): three deep notches between the pads as the approved has three. By its builder's own before line on one machine the miniature's part of M3 reads 0.874 with main's tree and 0.798 with the new one, so the pass costs 0.076, from darker bodies and far fewer bright leaves; the leaf fills 64 percent of the crown's hull against the approved's 52; the pale leaf rim is its weakest part in its builder's words. Held on those numbers: the bright leaves and the rim come first, then the push.

4K motion: chunk 58 of film B is drawn at 3840 by 2160, 30 frames, 123.4 s a frame in the mean on one helper. In the five lawn boxes no pair of frames stands out, no bright point lives for one frame alone, and the green sprinkle is about half of what it was in the right box. Two findings in the air for summer's air builder: seed heads that come into being in one frame (1767 to 1768) and seed heads crossing close to the lens. Not a pass: nobody has watched it play yet; the two video files are here for that. The bell test's numbers by 11:00 UTC.
The change of season: its builder redraws its four windows on chain 28's head; push about 12:00 UTC. Controls: job 5 (the reveal) taken; not a pass.

Below the bar, plainly. Summer: the crown too full and round, the base reads as grey weathered wood with clay dressings where the approved is pale packed sand with glassy pebbles and a scallop of about 14 broad ribs, seeds as cream stars of few spokes and too many of them in front of the house at rest, lights as even dots and large green discs, the glass's flame and top bands, the landing's feathers, the sand stream, the lawn as pale pointed cards at the close camera, the pond's water in wavy bands where the approved's is a smooth mirror. Fall: the air's points pale and hard, leaves of one shape and size, the roof, wall, fence and path as forms, the stone wall, no lights on the boughs. Spring: the crest, the roots, the moss's edge, the lit moss at 3840. The change of season, 4K motion and the controls as above.
Next: chain 28 read and pushed with its guard list; the miniature's and the tree's pushes decided on their reports; Round 23 on summer when its lists are in; watching chunk 58.

Render counts since the last status. Drawn here: the publish build's whole vitest and poster check; chain 28 in work. On helper machines: two page loads for the live check, the 30 frames of chunk 58 at 3840 (a motion test, not master frames), the builders' own stills. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
